hillside.blocks.title: Hillside: which blocks get slabs
hillside.blocks.hint: Off = no new slabs of this block. Giving a new block slabs needs a restart.
hillside.blocks.falling_tip: Slabs of sand, gravel and other falling blocks fall like the full block does.
hillside.blocks.falling_on: Hillside: sand and gravel slabs now fall like their blocks.
hillside.blocks.falling_off: Hillside: sand and gravel slabs no longer fall.
hillside.blocks.off: Hillside: %s slabs turned off; no new ones will generate.
hillside.blocks.on_restart: Hillside: %s will get slabs after a restart (on a server, players need the same config/hillside/blocks.json).
hillside.blocks.off_restart: Hillside: %s slabs turned off; they are removed after a restart.
hillside.blocks.unknown: Hillside: %s is not a block that can have a slab.
